climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A small Catalan DO on the Mediterranean coast just north of Barcelona, in Maresme county. Urban growth has shrunk it to a third. Allowed grapes include whites such as Xarello, Macabeo and Garnacha Blanca, plus several reds.
